title: K2 moment centroids give direction-dependent blend sensitivity for 27 HD 139139 dips
abstract: We test source-location sensitivity for the known irregular dips of HD 139139 with public K2 campaign 15 moment centroids. A local quadratic pointing fit retains 27 published events. Its depth-scaled centroid response has rank p = 0.133 against 164 accepted shifted event trains. No tested local window gives a response above its 5 percent reference threshold. At an ideal blend response of 0.83 pixel per fractional flux loss, recovery ranges from 20.7 to 100 percent across 16 directions. Thus, a null result with these moments cannot exclude a nearby source in all directions. Saturation, the box approximation and the selected time-shift reference limit the test. This does not locate the source, confirm an instrument cause, or find a new planet. The package contains code, aggregate results, figures, input hashes and a separate-input retrieval recipe.
